main_issue: Who covers the unfinished analysis section for Thursday's pitch while Agent D is away for a family bereavement

A-B.evidence: B refuses to take analysis work or stay late (T8, T10, T19, T21), and A insists 'This is not a request' (T20). A later drops the demand and says 'The rest of you, just get your own sections done' (T24).

A-C.evidence: C says a walkthrough isn't enough and asks who will lead (T14, T17). A takes the lead and says C will support (T18), then lets everyone just do their own sections (T24). C never explicitly agrees.

A-D.evidence: A first assumes D's section will be taken over (T7). D then offers to finish it from home (T23), and A accepts: 'thank you. That settles it' (T24, T28).

B-C.evidence: Both decline the analysis work for their own reasons (T8-T10, T11, T14). Neither addresses the other, and both end up doing only their own sections.

B-D.evidence: B offers condolences (T4) and D thanks B (T5). D's offer to work from home (T23) resolves the issue B had resisted, but they never discuss it.

C-D.evidence: C never speaks to D. D's offer to finish the analysis (T23) removes C's problem, but there is no direct exchange.
